title: Code and archived results for "Integrative multi-cohort transcriptomics of cGAS-STING-associated type I interferon signaling and MHC class I antigen processing in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury" (v2.2.2)
description: Code, archived results and figures for the revised manuscript HELIYON-D-26-05075. The main reported numbers are listed in results/number_ledger.csv; all other values are in the result files under results/. See CHANGELOG.md for changes since v2.2.1 (no analysis was changed; figures and supplementary tables show current official MGI gene symbols, and American spelling is used).
